one_line: Empirical statistical analysis of Italian energy-audit and energy-management-system data across four sectors (plastics product manufacturing, ceramics, retail, banks) to assess the impact of monitoring/ISO 50001 on energy performance improvement actions; registered continuous-flow sectors (steel, paper, cement) appear only as dataset descriptors or citations.
